verdict.rationale: Groq's first-party docs say it is OpenAI-compatible: an agent switches by changing only `base_url` to `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1` and the API key, using the standard OpenAI client libraries. The standard Chat Completions surface is also documented, including streaming, a `tools` parameter for function calling and JSON-schema structured outputs, with the Responses API described as fully compatible. Missing for 10: Groq itself calls the API only "mostly compatible" and does not list which parameters differ, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation of switching providers mid-workflow without code changes.
